brand.name: Kairo
brand.description: An AI concierge that catches high-intent visitors. Built by Baazi Suufi. Currently in demo mode, strictly for Upwork clients.

typography.heading: Outfit, sans-serif
typography.instructions: Use font-light for subheadings and font-bold/black for impact headers. All large headings (>text-4xl) MUST have tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.

visual_enhancers.backgrounds: Overlay the background with the custom .noise and .dot-grid utilities. Use .float-orb for neon-green glowing shapes behind the hero and waitlist sections.
visual_enhancers.buttons: Implement the .btn-luxe class for primary CTAs: high-contrast dark background, neon green border (1px), subtle green glow shadow, and a shiny highlight effect on hover.
visual_enhancers.cards: Use .glass for panels with a 1px border-white/10. Apply .neon-glow-hover to feature grid items.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Must use backdrop-blur-xl with a slightly saturated, low-opacity background (e.g., bg-white/5) for headers/nav to maintain high optical clarity.

layouts.hero: flex-col items-center text-center justify-center min-h-[90vh] max-w-5xl mx-auto. Heavy use of negative space.
layouts.use_cases: Bento 'Tetris' Grid. 1 dominant hero card (col-span-full md:col-span-8), and smaller supporting cards (md:col-span-4). Wide gap-8.
layouts.features: Dense high-contrast technical grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4.

shopify_use_case.description: 3D cart/dashboard representation for the Shopify Store Owner card

marketing_use_case.description: Dark glow analytics dashboard for the Ads/Marketing Agency card

abstract_glow_background.description: Defocus green bokeh - position with opacity-20 mixed mode behind UI layers

abstract_orb.description: Glowing orb to use creatively within the Waitlist booking card.

sections_blueprint.name: Header / Sticky Nav
sections_blueprint.elements: Logo 'Kairo' (font-bold text-xl), nav links, 'Client Login' subtle link, and 'Book on Upwork' CTA btn-luxe.

sections_blueprint.name: Hero Section
sections_blueprint.layout: Centered alignment, large padding (py-32), relative wrapper with float-orb inside.
sections_blueprint.elements:
1. Banner/Badge: '🚨 IN DEMO MODE — UPWORK CLIENTS ONLY' (Neon green border, very small uppercase text, pill shape).
2. H1: 'Kairo. The right moment.' (Huge, tracking-tighter, gradient-text-primary).
3. Subtitle: 'An AI concierge that catches high-intent visitors.'
4. Actions: 'Reserve Your Spot' (btn-luxe) and 'See How It Works' (ghost button).

sections_blueprint.name: Integrations Marquee
sections_blueprint.elements: Use marquee-track utility. Text items separated by a .star element. Text: Shopify, WordPress, Webflow, Wix, Squarespace.

sections_blueprint.name: Use Cases Bento Grid
sections_blueprint.layout: Container max-w-7xl mx-auto py-24. CSS Grid with varied spans.
sections_blueprint.elements: Card 1 (Large): 'Shopify store owner who just needs a fix' + image 'shopify_use_case'. Card 2 (Medium): 'Ads/Marketing person needing high conversions' + image 'marketing_use_case'. Card 3 (Small): 'General SMB looking for automation'. Use .glass and .neon-glow-hover.

sections_blueprint.name: Feature Grid
sections_blueprint.layout: Grid cols-1 md:cols-2 lg:cols-4 gap-4 py-24
sections_blueprint.elements: Cards for: FAQ answers, Upsells, Order tracking, Photo-to-product, 95+ languages, Unified inbox, Voice call, Human handoff. Use Lucide-react icons, subtle 1px border, neon green accent on hover.

sections_blueprint.name: Reservation / Waitlist Area
sections_blueprint.layout: Massive callout box, centered, dark surface, glowing orb image in background (mix-blend-screen).
sections_blueprint.elements: H2: 'Not Available to the Public.' Sub: 'Kairo is exclusively offered to Upwork clients. Book a consultation with Baazi Suufi to reserve your waitlist spot.' CTA: 'Book on Upwork to Wait' (massive shiny button).

sections_blueprint.name: Testimonials
sections_blueprint.elements: Featured CEO review card (large text, high contrast) and 1 supporting review card. Mention 'Rozio-Killer' evolution.

sections_blueprint.name: Footer
sections_blueprint.layout: Massive padding py-32 bg-black border-t border-white/10
sections_blueprint.elements: Huge 'Let's Talk' text (text-[10vw]), Upwork link, Logo, Copyright 2026 Kairo.

custom_css_utilities_to_add: .noise { background-image: url('data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox=%220 0 200 200%22 xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%3E%3Cfilter id=%22noiseFilter%22%3E%3CfeTurbulence type=%22fractalNoise%22 baseFrequency=%220.65%22 numOctaves=%223%22 stitchTiles=%22stitch%22/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width=%22100%25%22 height=%22100%25%22 filter=%22url(%23noiseFilter)%22/%3E%3C/svg%3E'); opacity: 0.04; mix-blend-mode: overlay; pointer-events: none; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 50; }
.glass { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); box-shadow: 0 4px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); }

.btn-luxe { position: relative; background: #0B1016; color: #48BB78; border: 1px solid #48BB78; padding: 0.75rem 2rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; transition: all 0.3s ease; box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(72, 187, 120, 0.2); overflow: hidden; }
.btn-luxe:hover { background: #48BB78; color: #0B1016; box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(72, 187, 120, 0.5); transform: translateY(-2px); }

.btn-luxe::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -50%; left: -50%; width: 200%; height: 200%; background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.3), transparent); transform: rotate(45deg); transition: 0.5s; opacity: 0; }
.marquee-track { display: flex; animation: scroll-left 20s linear infinite; white-space: nowrap; }
.marquee-track-reverse { display: flex; animation: scroll-right 20s linear infinite; white-space: nowrap; }
.float-orb { position: absolute; border-radius: 50%; filter: blur(100px); opacity: 0.3; animation: float-slow 10s ease-in-out infinite; background: #48BB78; }
.fade-up { animation: fade-up 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards; opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); }

.link-underline::after { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 100%; transform: scaleX(0); height: 1px; bottom: 0; left: 0; background-color: #48BB78; transform-origin: bottom right; transition: transform 0.25s ease-out; }
instructions_to_main_agent: Inject the custom_css_utilities_to_add directly into the src/index.css file (or App.css) to establish the brand's 'WOW' premium dark aesthetic.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Install/use 'Outfit' or 'Cabinet Grotesk' if possible, otherwise rely on the default sans with strong tracking limits.
Implement the 'Kairo' landing page using raw HTML+Tailwind for layout structure (bento grids, asymmetric overlapping).
Avoid Shadcn Cards if they feel too boxed in; favor raw div wrappers with the .glass utility and .neon-glow-hover.
Crucial requirement: Make the hero completely centered, and highlight the Upwork-exclusive/Demo-mode nature right away at the very top.
Use Framer Motion or the custom .fade-up utility to cascade elements into view on mount.
Create a 'Book to Wait' reservation block that acts as a strong CTA, distinct from standard SaaS signup buttons. Use the 'Book on Upwork' wording specifically.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur). DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in headers or overlays.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in css. Center align explicit sections like Hero only.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
